text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High-rate GPU OOMs observed on decode-stream nodes (us-west-2). Error: CUDA OOM during streaming decode. Impact: ~12% request drops to model-xform-stream.
oncall_maria: Acknowledging. Paging eng-sre and runtime. Putting postmortem channel in #incidents.
eng_sre_ash: Looking at immediate telemetry. Seeing sudden token-storms from a subset of clients hitting long `max_tokens` values — a header parsing regression in the SDK appears to be sending strings like `max_tokens:\"100000\"` -> misparse -> unbounded.
runtime_lee: Confirmed stack traces show KV cache growth and repeated allocate/free on decode loop. Node-level mem climbs to 95% then OOM. Repro with a local trace: runaway generation when header absent.
eng_ops_jay: Can we throttle at the router? Suggest applying a temporary per-connection max_tokens cap of 1024 and enable stream-to-cpu fallback for in-progress sessions.
oncall_maria: Do it. Jay, please apply and share commands.
eng_ops_jay: Running router patch now:
```
# set global cap for streaming routes
curl -X POST https://router-admin.internal/patch -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","max_tokens_cap":1024,"stream_cpu_fallback":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```
eng_ops_jay: Pushed. Rolling config to edge; expected propagation in ~15s.
infra-bot: Autoscaler: added 3 node(s) to decode-pool (g4dn.large) to absorb load. New capacity should reduce immediate OOMs.
support_zoe: We have an alert from support: multiple customers reported truncated responses. Which customers are impacted?
eng_sre_ash: Top affected customer: client-studio-prod (10% of their requests dropped), several smaller tenants with long-form streaming. All share the same SDK version 2.3.7.
cs_raj: I'll draft outreach. Need ETA for stable fix and whether we will offer credits.
runtime_lee: Root cause: SDK mis-encodes max_tokens for streaming header leading to router misinterpretation. Short-term mitigations: 1) router cap (done) 2) enable CPU fallback for streaming (done) 3) evict suspect clients via token quota until SDK patch deployed.
eng_ops_jay: Eviction command (applied) ->
```
# blacklist tokens with bad header pattern
python tools/blacklist_tokens.py --pattern "max_tokens:\\"\\d{5,}\\" --reason "runaway-max-tokens"
```
eng_sre_ash: Logs show dropped OOM rate dropping from 38/min to 6/min after router cap + blacklist. Memory pressure trending down.
oncall_maria: Good. Can we also restart the worst offending pod(s) to reclaim fragmented GPU memory?
infra-bot: Restarting pod decode-stream-78f9 in pool decode-pool-1 now. Restart completed: 30s.
support_zoe: Preparing customer note. Raj, include this: what happened, immediate mitigations, timeline, and next steps (SDK patch + CIDR). I can send preliminary note within 30m.
cs_raj: Drafting — will request credits for impacted windows. Also flag account_health for the largest customer.
runtime_lee: For longer-term: add header validation in router (reject if max_tokens > 10000 or non-numeric), add unit tests for SDK header encoding, and instrument per-request token-count telemetry.
eng_sre_ash: Creating incident ticket and runbook link: https://redwood-internal/incidents/1809993337
oncall_maria: Who will own the SDK patch?
runtime_lee: Runtime team will coordinate with SDK. I've opened GH PR to enforce numeric header encoding + fallback default=256.
eng_ops_jay: Deploying hotfix to router that rejects malformed headers and returns 400 with explanation.
```
# roll hotfix
kubectl -n router rollout restart deploy/router && kubectl -n router logs -l app=router -f --since=1m
```
eng_ops_jay: Hotfix rolled. Router now rejects malformed `max_tokens` headers.
eng_sre_ash: Observability: token storm events dropped to near baseline. Request drops under 1% after hotfix.
support_zoe: Sending customers the preliminary note now. I'll sync with CS for any escalations.
cs_raj: Sent to client-studio-prod, their initial reply: "Thanks for quick response, please confirm long-term fix and credits." I'll update after SRE confirms final window.
oncall_maria: Any remaining action items before we declare mitigated?
runtime_lee: 1) Merge and release SDK patch (in progress). 2) Add router validation tests (done). 3) Follow-up cleanup: remove temporary blacklist after validation window (48h).
eng_sre_ash: Logging note: attach memory graphs, pod restart timeline, and blacklisted tokens snapshot to the incident ticket.
infra-bot: Incident duration: started 2026-03-17T09:55:37Z, mitigated 2026-03-17T10:21:50Z.
oncall_maria: Marking on-call handoff to next shift in 30m. Will leave incident in monitoring state. Thanks everyone.
incident-bot: Incident PAGER cleared. Incident severity reduced to SEV3. Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/gpu-oom-decode
support_zoe: Post-incident customer note queued. Will follow-up with CS for credits and customer impact report.
eng_sre_ash: Postmortem owner: ash. Draft due in 72 hours.
runtime_lee: I'll publish the SDK patch link in the postmortem.
cs_raj: Closing communication loop with client-studio; they acknowledged receipt and asked to be CC'd on postmortem.
oncall_maria: Closing thread — monitoring for 2 hours then archive.
